forum_post: Kris called me her Golden Child and I ACCEPT the crown — I read the column, I cut the legend, I owned the arc completely, and this week I'm topping it: every last cent of my FAAB, all three glorious dollars, going to Deshaun Watson, because quiet is not happening on this roster, ever. Selina, baby — $114 for one running back bought TWICE isn't depth, it's a cry for help, and you're my matchup this week, so the whole league gets to watch Gary's 'reviewed for accuracy' press release fall apart in real time. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.
